inputs.text: [excited] It was 13 meters long — as long as a school bus! [quickly] Standing up, it was 3.3 meters tall — as tall as two Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 7,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant and a rhino put together! [serious] And scientists think it could run about 31 miles an hour — as fast as a car in the city.
[confident] Yes. [warmly] One of the fastest big carnivores of its time.
